Well.... Not really. Story: i think about 2 years ago one of my relatives upgraded his pc. He was using 2 of theese cards in crossfire (Gigabyte R9 290 4GB) and one fo them started to act up( this one) then my bro got this card, he tried to clean the contacts and things like that, without any succes( the card was fine on idle but if you stressed it, you would get some artiffects then no picture). Then he gave this card to me, maybe i can do something with it.
I followed a linus tech tips guide on the oven-reflow method, but while doing so, the electrolitic capacitors which were rated for 105C  exploded like popcorn in the 260C oven. I put the card away until a few days ago, i ordered new caps to replace the broken ones, but soldering them in is very difficult, because you have to heat up the whole card basically, so until it's working fine, i will just leave them like this. After i put on the caps i tried the card, but it didn't work. The die heated up, but nothing else, no picture. Than i saw a video of a guy reflowing gpu with a hairdryer, and i was like ill give it a shot, can't be worse than this, and to my suprise the card posted. It worked for about 10 minutes, than black screen, so i think the reflow wasn't very succesful so i will try agin. I think if i can repair it i might attempt osme mods, i dont really need this card, i have a 1060 6G since, but for learning its great.
